{{Quote|You don’t want to do that, ma’am. She couldn’t pilot a landspeeder right now.|Ody Mandrell on Rao|<ref name="TG" />}}
'''Rao''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike racer on the old [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]]. She built a swoop bike, which was basically a [[Podracer engine/Legends|Podracer engine]] with a seat attached. Although the bike was extremely fast, it was responsible for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of six people, after which [[Ulda]], the owner of the Grand Arena, bought it.<ref name="TG" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] searched for the painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]''. Ulda gave them Rao's [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike to chase down her [[Marriage/Legends|ex-husband]] [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] who stole the painting from the auction.<ref name="TG" />
